senses.gloss:
1. ऋच् cl. 6. P. ऋचति, आनर्च, अर्चिता, &c., = 1. अर्च्, p. 89, col. 3;
to praise, Dhātup. xxviii, 19 (cf. अर्क॑.)

2. ऋ॑च् f. praise, verse, esp. a sacred verse recited in praise of a deity (in contradistinction to the Sāman [pl. Sāmāni] or verses which were sung and to the Yajus [pl. Yajūṃṣi] or sacrificial words, formularies, and verses which were muttered)
sacred text, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr. &c., Mn. &c.
the collection of the Ṛc verses (sg., but usually pl. ऋ॑चस्), the Ṛg-veda, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr. & ĀśvGṛ.; Mn. i, 23, &c. (cf. ऋग्-वेद above)
the text of the Pūrvatāpanīya, RāmatUp.
